title: Fair Day Reaction
scenarioIntro: A 34-year-old woman develops hives, lip swelling and wheeze after eating at a fall fair food truck. Tests recognition of anaphylaxis and early IM epinephrine.

patientDemographics.name: Tessa Morrow
patientDemographics.appearance: Sitting on a curb, flushed, anxious, hives on neck and arms

patientPresentation: Speaking in short sentences, audible wheeze, lips swollen.
incidentNarrative: Ate a satay skewer 15 minutes ago. Knows she is allergic to peanuts. Left her auto-injector at home.

physicalExam.airway: Lips and tongue swollen, voice hoarse
physicalExam.skin: Urticaria on neck, chest and arms

withProperTreatment: Wheeze eases and BP recovers within 5 minutes of epinephrine

expectedTreatment: Epinephrine IM per the anaphylaxis directive, as soon as anaphylaxis is recognized
Diphenhydramine per the anaphylaxis directive after epinephrine
Oxygen titrated to the patient's saturation
Consider salbutamol if wheeze persists after epinephrine
Do not delay transport to give antihistamine
protocolNotes: ALS PCS Moderate to Severe Allergic Reaction Medical Directive
